name: MCP2515
description: The MCP2515 communicates with ESPHome via the [SPI bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi); to use it, you must have at least one [SPI bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi) with both the `mosi_pin` and `miso_pin` defined in your ESPHome configuration.

config_entries.label: Can ID
config_entries.description: default *CAN ID* used for transmitting frames.

config_entries.label: CS Pin
config_entries.description: Is used to signal to a SPI device when it should listen for data on the SPI bus. Each SPI device has its own `CS` line. Sometimes also called `SS`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

config_entries.label: Bit Rate
config_entries.description: One of the supported bit rates. See [this table](https://esphome.io/components/canbus/esp32_can#esp32-can-bit-rate) for a list of supported bit rates by the internal CAN (TWAI) controllers of different ESP32 variants. Defaults to `125KBPS`.

config_entries.label: Clock
config_entries.description: The frequency of the clock crystal used on the MCP2515 device. One of `8MHZ`, `12MHZ`, `16MHZ` or `20MHZ`. Defaults to `8MHZ`.

config_entries.label: Max Frames Per Loop
config_entries.description: Maximum number of received CAN frames processed in one pass of the main loop. Frames still queued after that are handled on the next pass, so one burst cannot stall the rest of the firmware. A warning is logged each time the limit is reached, since the receive queue may overflow and drop frames if it keeps happening. Must be at least `1`. Defaults to `50`.

options.label: LOOPBACK
options.description: Loopback mode is useful for testing your connections to/from the device.
